title: I don’t enjoy using this
text: I don’t enjoy using this. Eh, not my favorite. The teeny molds are lined up on 1 mat and can cause trouble when you’re trying to pop them out. Cool concept but when you’re working with steaming loaves of bread, I’ve realize silicone isn’t the best baking medium. I wouldn’t order this again.

product_metadata.title: Silpat Perfect Mini Fluted Cake Mold
features: Features a non-stick coating which makes it easy to get the cake out whole.
Durable, long lasting and easy to clean.
Can be used in the freezer, refrigerator, oven, and microwave.
Perfect material for bakeware; flexible and heat resistant.
description: Silpat baking molds are perfect for baking just about any delicacy you want. The baking molds are made of non-stick silicone which means you’ll spend less time cleaning and more time enjoying your baking creations. Silpat replaces the need for butter, grease, oils, and sprays.

details.Product Care Instructions: Wipe clean, wash with soft sponge and air dry.
